question: Show a bar chart of total sales by category.

spec.sql: SELECT category, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM orders GROUP BY category
spec.title: Total Sales by Category

question: Show a bar chart of total profit by region.

spec.sql: SELECT region, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM orders GROUP BY region
spec.title: Total Profit by Region

question: Show a pie chart of order count by segment.

spec.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY segment
spec.title: Order Count by Segment

question: Show a bar chart of average discount by ship mode.

spec.sql: SELECT ship_mode, AVG(discount) AS average_discount FROM orders GROUP BY ship_mode
spec.title: Average Discount by Ship Mode

question: Show a line chart of monthly sales in 2017.

spec.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2017' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
spec.title: Monthly Sales in 2017

question: Show a bar chart of total quantity sold by sub-category.

spec.sql: SELECT sub_category, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders GROUP BY sub_category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
spec.title: Total Quantity Sold by Sub-Category

question: Show a boxplot of profit for orders in the Consumer segment.

spec.sql: SELECT profit FROM orders WHERE segment = 'Consumer'
spec.title: Profit Distribution for Consumer Segment

question: Show a histogram of sales values under $500.

spec.sql: SELECT sales FROM orders WHERE sales < 500
spec.title: Histogram of Sales Under $500

question: Show a scatter plot of discount versus profit for orders in the Technology category.

spec.sql: SELECT discount, profit FROM orders WHERE category = 'Technology'
spec.title: Discount vs Profit (Technology Category)

question: Show a line chart of profit over time for the East region in 2017.

spec.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM orders WHERE region = 'East' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2017' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
spec.title: Profit Over Time - East Region 2017
